title: The Perils and Promise of Relationships
heading: The Perils and Promise of Relationships

sourceRefs.role: chapter title and official positioning support

coreClaim: Relationships remain worth pursuing, but trust becomes vulnerable where truth bias and online deception are present.
distinctMechanism: The same openness that makes relationships possible can also create exposure to misrepresentation.
requiredAnchors: Trust can be exploited when deception enters.
Truth bias and online misrepresentation create special risk.
specificApplications: Approach online connection with more verification than assumption.
Keep openness without collapsing into naivete.
Slow down when trust signals and evidence diverge.
commonMisreadings: The answer is to trust nobody.
Online relationship risk makes connection pointless.
hardEdgeRequirement: Hard depth must preserve both the value of connection and the risk of deception without overclaiming beyond the frozen support.
thresholdQuestion: How do you stay open enough for connection without becoming easy to deceive?
